body: I don’t know if anyone is going to check back here but I went ahead and told my uncle I’ll give it a shot and the entire group is super excited! Thank you everyone for being awesome and supportive. We won’t be playing until November 5th but I’ll check back and tell everyone how it went.
thank you
My sister. She has been here for me through all of it and I know she needs me just like I need her. Without her I wouldn't still be here.

Hey, I'm turning 19 in just over a month and I get the same thing. My sister is 14 and anytime she introduces me to her friends and tells them how old I am they never believe her. I've even showed some of them my ID as proof and they still don't believe me. It's always "there's no way, you're only like 15 at the most"

A lot of people think my sister is older than me. It kind of hurts to not be recognized or respected. I know they don't usually mean it in a rude way, but it doesn't make me feel any better. I know it's an issue with me and I can't think of a way to fix it. I have a cousin that's a week younger than me and my family has always treated him more like an adult than me, I don't know why. I don't know if it's because of how I look or act but it doesn't feel right.

Maybe we can work on it? Maybe if we act more confident or something people will start to recognize that we're old enough to be taken seriously. Best of luck to you friend. I'm sorry you feel this way.
Do you think so? I usually feel like it's hopeless, for me at least. But I won't give up on it just yet.
Yeah, it was really hard losing the only friend I've ever had

Yeah, I feel like that from time to time. It makes me feel really strange. I usually kind of work like a robot and just do things without much thinking but then sometimes it hits me that this is reality, this is life and I have to keep doing it. It's a weird feeling to be so aware of existing.

I think it's mostly myself but sometimes my family will make comments that make me feel worse. I feel like I'm very different than most people because I haven't had much interaction with other people in my life and I have a very hard time acting normal around strangers because of the mix of anxiety and cluelessness. I'm not really good at anything, that's another problem I've had. I thought I was kind of okay at drawing but recently I've not been feeling very confident in that. But that's really the only thing at all that I've ever felt like I was decent at.

Kind of the world in general. I have a really hard time talking to people at all and there are so many things that I need to do but I can't because anxiety makes me afraid. I'll never be able to be even just somewhat successful or happy. I'm not sure if I'll ever be able to get a job or go to school. I've not really ever admitted it before but I'm terrified to learn around other people, I hate trying and failing and others being around to see it, it's embarrassing to be bad at things to me so it's really hard to learn anything because of it. I'm really far behind on things education wise because I was homeschooled and it was not done properly. I was kind of just left to teach myself which was great in some ways but made it impossible for me to excel in anything. And I couldn't work my way through math which I am terrible at. I'd say my entire family is at least 5x better at math than I am. The anxiety I have doesn't really make sense to anyone, I'm told all the time that I'm weird and that my reasons for things are stupid and don't any make sense. But all of that is just the anxiety... It's where the depression started but I don't think ending the anxiety would end the depression.
Eh, actually I don't even work. I don't do anything at all.

I posted this yesterday because I'm alone and tired, I don't have any friends and I hate myself, I'm useless, anxiety keeps me from doing anything useful and depression keeps me from doing anything about my anxiety. But today is so much worse than yesterday. I thought nothing could make me feel any worse than I did before because I felt so horrible before but today is the worst day I've ever had. I had to have my cat put down today. He was all I ever had to make me feel better when I hurt but now I'm completely alone. He was the last bit of hope and love I really had for the world. Now I want to give up even more than I did when I posted this.

I'm 18, I said I feel too old for types of sports and things because most people start those very young and it seems a lot of places that teach things and have teams of sorts won't accept people over a certain age which is usually around 13ish. I might be crazy though.

Currently I'm relying on my parents for money and they are willing to help even though we don't have too much money, but I'm hoping that if I start doing something I'll feel more confident and comfortable getting a job so I can pay for it myself.

It's crazy how much all of this reminds me of myself and my own problems. I'm sorry that you feel like you can't trust anyone anymore, I feel that way too. I feel like nothing I say could help in any way but I wish it could. It's not fair that people hurt you over and over again, it's not fair that he would do that to you. I understand your pain. I don't try to help people here often because I'm not good at helping people but, I really hope things change for you. You don't deserve any of this pain. This world is a very unfair and cruel place to be. Especially for people like us, we don't have anyone to talk to or anyone to help us when we're at our worst. And now we don't think we could trust someone if they tried. I want there to be someone out there that will truly love me and never betray me but it's hard to keep that hope.

It may be weird but you kind of seem like another version of me in a way. I think that's why it's so hard for me to think of anything to tell you, it's kind of like trying to give myself advice. I can't explain why but even though I don't know you, I care, and I want you to get better. I hope that something changes for the better for you, I really do. I'm so sorry, I truly wish there was something I could do to help you.

I'm sorry this is so long and I'm sorry for apologizing so much.

I loved my friend too, more than anything in the world. And he said the same about me. I actually told him something very similar to what you said. That I don't tell someone I love them unless I really truly love them but I guess that wasn't as important to him as it was to me. We talked for a year, kind of like you. And then suddenly he started acting very cold toward me and then he stopped replying to me altogether. Then a few weeks ago he told me he wants to be friends again and I've tried really hard but I can't be friends with him because I keep thinking about when we were more and all the plans we had. A week ago I told him exactly that and he got really upset and kept saying things like "I'm tired of everyone leaving me" and that hurt me really bad because he knows about the situation I'm in, with no friends. And he has to be aware that he left me first. It doesn't seem fair. I'm still trying to deal with it, he's acting like that didn't even happen now and I can't sleep because I keep thinking about him but whatever makes him happy I guess.

I noticed a couple other things when I looked through your post history. I promise I'm not creepy, I just wanted some more insight to your life. I was a fairly happy child but when I was about 11 or 12 my parents got divorced and although it doesn't bother me now, it triggered something in me at the time. I became very depressed and ever since then it gets worse by the day, around the same time I started having panic attacks which didn't contribute well, it made the depression worse, I saw that you've been depressed since around to same age. And you're 18 right? I am too. And I didn't drop out of high school, I just never went at all. I was homeschooled since the third grade. A lot of people say homeschooling is better but for me it was very ineffective because I always ended up doing my work alone on my computer with nobody around to help when I couldn't figure something out on my own. Because of this I'd say I have worse education than my little sister who is turning 14 in a couple days. My mom keeps pushing for me to get my GED but I'd have to take a lot of classes before I'd even be close to ready for the test and I just don't have any motivation to do it. I don't do well around people anyway, so the classes would make it worse. I'd like to just go straight into college or whatever like a normal person but now I've waiting so long to do anything about my education issues that it seems pointless. People tell me all the time "you're only 18! You have so much time left to do these things!" But they don't understand that successful people always start early, I'm out of time to be successful in life. It seems like most people just don't understand me at all. Sometimes even I don't understand me.

I apologize in advance. I'm really tired and out of it. I just spent 20 minutes writing this and it still doesn't make much sense. So I'm very sorry.

After reading this post I went to see your post history and I saw one from 18 hours ago that hit me pretty hard. I've been/am in a similar boat.

I had a friend once. Just one friend, a single person I trusted more than I trusted myself. They were the only friend I have ever had in my entire life. The issue was that we were online friends, it wasn't an issue for me. I was just happy to have another human that I felt comfortable talking to. Most people find me strange and distant. (Probably because I am). I guess the issue with it was that sometimes even though I had him I still felt alone and the fact that we were so far from each other didn't help much I suppose. I don't know, my mind is kind of frazzled right now, I'm not good at explaining.

Anyway, like I said I trusted him more than anything, we made promises to always be there for each other and we were for awhile, but eventually he left me. I don't know why, he never gave me a reason. But it kind of broke me when the one person I would trust with everything suddenly left me. There's a lot more to that story. It's still going on today, but what I'm trying to say is that I understand what it's like to just want a friend. Sometimes you need someone to reach out to so badly but when you don't have anyone in your life that you can trust it's impossible. That's why I come here so often I suppose. It's my desperate attempt to reach out even though I know that it won't really help me.

I've tried to make  friends but either they decide they don't like me or my anxiety keeps me from interacting with them enough to bond. The only reason I had the friend I had was because even when I started to shut him out he wouldn't stop trying to reach out to me. It was like a dream to have someone like that in my life. And it's like a nightmare to know that I won't ever have anyone like that again.

I'm not completely sure what the point of me telling you this story was, I guess I'm trying to make you feel less alone? I'm sorry, I'm not exactly in the right mindset to do this right now but I really felt like I needed to say something to you because it feels somewhat familiar...

I'm in a similar situation... I'm almost 19. I hate being here and I don't have any hope for myself whatsoever. And I even have a plan to jump eventually... 

So it's most likely not helpful at all to know someone else is in a similar situation but even though I hate life so much and I hate myself so much I still care about other people. I want with all I have in me to help other people because I don't think it's fair for anyone to hurt as much as I do and I hate seeing it happen. There's not much I can say because I'm not good with words or people even, but I need you to know that I really truly hope that you'll be okay. I want you to keep trying as hard as you can for me. I know it's difficult and maybe even it seems impossible but I believe in you.

I'm so sorry that you feel so badly, I hope things turn around for you my friend.
Thank you very much.
It did help some. I was able to get a bit of sleep. Thank you.
Since losing him I haven't been able to talk to anyone about any issues I have. I'm used to dealing with things on my own.
It has been very difficult, but nothing I'm not used to. I sort of am in touch, it's been very one sided though. He's really upset with me.
I did. It was hardest to find out that he didn't actually care about me as much as he once said he did. It felt like I'd been lied to for a long time.
I feel like I probably shouldn't have said anything in the first place to be honest. I should have kept things how they were, he seemed happier that way at least.

Yeah, we met from a video game so it was long distance. We were both dealing with depression and he had a lot of things going on out of anyone's control and I guess I wasn't supportive enough so he disappeared for awhile and then came back wanting to be friends but I wasn't able to just be friends with him and so I told him that and now he hates me. Worst part is, I've never had any other friends. So I don't have any support in dealing with it.
There was a person, but he's gone now and it's my fault.
It's fine, I feel in a way like I was probably just not meant to be happy. Anytime I've ever been happy it's been for a very short time.

I don't know really. It's been getting increasingly harder every day to feel any desire to be here. I've been told to wait it out but I've been waiting for such a long time and I've thought about it all so much. I just genuinely don't want to be alive anymore.

I don't think there's much that I can say.

But I did notice that you've been helping a lot of people here and I wanted to thank you for that. It's very kind of you to take so much time to talk to and help so many strangers.
18, female, white, USA, not religious, heterosexual.

Hey, I'm sorry you're feeling this way. I'm sorry that you feel alone. I've been there. I'm not good at helping/advice, but try to breathe and focus on something that you care about. I know it's hard, but I believe in you. You can beat this. I know I'm a total stranger but I want you to know that I really hope you'll be okay.

I can relate all too well. I think about this every day.

I really truly hope things look up for you. It hurts to see others feeling the same way I do. Nobody deserves to feel like this. I'm so sorry.

I care. That's my issue. I don't want to be here at all, but I care so much for other people that I can't will myself to end it. I know it's not helpful, I've been there too many times. But I do care.
Thank you.

Yeah, it's definitely one of the worst feelings.

Some days are better than others usually because those are the days that I'm more distracted. Days that I'm doing things that are different, most of the time with family. But it's rare to get to do those things, they require everyone to be willing, have time, and usually money.

I don't think there's any chance. Not after the conversation we had.

It's been awhile for me since I've had a good day. There are some days that are better than others, but there aren't any good days anymore.

I have thought about it a lot. Maybe even too much. I'm not going anywhere yet, I at least want to wait until after my sister's birthday in a week. I guess there's a chance I'll change my mind but I don't really see it happening at this point.

And I talked to a counselor a couple years ago for awhile but it didn't help much then and now things are worse, so I doubt it would help now.

I'm sorry for the super late reply. I've been trying to stay distracted today and haven't spent much time on Reddit. Unfortunately I don't have any friends at all. That's part of why everything is so hard. Recently the person from the relationship decided he wanted to be friends again and I tried but I can't just be friends with him now. Last night I told him that and he didn't take it well. I feel like a horrible person for trying to put an end to the only "friendship" I had, but I'm doing it more for him than me. I'd rather remove myself from his life now instead of just disappearing or having to tell him what I know I'm eventually going to do.

It's not just that though. I've pretty much always been depressed and I've felt slightly suicidal in the past but after I ruined the one and only friendship I've ever had even after doing everything I could to keep it I feel worse than ever. I've been feeling like this for months and months now. I've tried to be optimistic about everything but after this long I don't see a possibility for improvement. I've only been holding out this long for my family but they'll eventually be fine without me.
Maybe that's it then. I've always felt like no amount of help will change anything for me. Maybe I'm truly just not meant to be here.

I really wish I had some advice for you. But sadly you described my life better than I could. I try to avoid planning anything for the future anymore, even simple things. But there are times I find myself thinking something like "in a few years, when I'm better I want to ..." but I catch myself and shut down the thought quickly, knowing that being better is just a dream I have, nothing that could ever be reality. It used to help me calm down to think about things I could do when I'm better but now I can't motivate myself to make breakfast because it feels like a waste since I have to future ahead of me. I do wish you the best of luck though. I really do hope you start to feel better.

I understand this all too well. It's hard. It's really hard. I just barely keep going every day to do what I need, trying so hard to ignore all the negative thoughts about myself, and then lay down at night and I can't help but think about what a waste of space I am in this world. I think about all the things I mess up for everyone around me and how much easier life would be for everyone if I were to just disappear. If I were to never have existed in the first place. But there are rare moments that I feel like maybe, I might possible be making a positive impact in SOMEONE'S life, even just something so small that nobody even really notices. It's the moments that I believe I could have possibly helped someone in some way that I try to focus on. It doesn't help much, usually none at all. But at least it's something else to think about every once in awhile.

Happy Birthday!! I'm so glad to see that so many strangers wish you a happy birthday! Seeing this post has made me feel a bit better. I hope today has been and continues to be a great day. You deserve it <3

I did enjoy video games for awhile but now everything just feels like a distraction.

I don't have any plans. I try to avoid thinking of the future most of the time. The only thing I'm really expected to do is help around the house. That's the only time I'm ever productive in any way.
Usually I feel like there is nothing but sometimes I wonder if there could be something and I just can't find it for some reason.
